name: attribution-off-pump
title: F8 process attribution off the pump thread with an owner-table snapshot cache
description: Structural finding F8 of 09-29-tcp-udp-path-structural-perf: with any process rule configured, every new host flow synchronously runs a system-wide connection-table enumeration plus process-open work on the capture pump thread, with a 2 ms retry on a miss - 0.5-7 ms per new flow, tens of new flows per second during browsing bursts, while allocating megabytes per second of transient garbage. Measured: a 50 ms per-flow stall moves the pooled p99 from 8.3 ms to ~52 ms and a new flow allocates ~91 KB.
creator: qmazon
